name: fleet-glue
description: Reduces standup friction across Nestor, Jeles, and willow-mcp without laundering trust. Wires the established-lane recognizer via the shipped cascade seam (no monkeypatch), dual-writes gaps, corroborates claims into Nestor drafts, threads willow gap_ids through jeles promotion, and reads back Seal / Known / Reject / Gaps for triage. Never seals. Nothing here promotes a rung on its own — advisory_ratify calls willow_mcp.mem_ratify and returns the Decision, and every write lands as draft with citation warrants attached.
author: USER

data_streams.purpose: Per-lab NESTOR_DB, ledger, seal.key, willow_home and SOIL root — one operator directory tree the standup command sets up

notes.status: Seeded from lab. 26/26 in the operator drive (see tests/test_drive.py). Nestor decision-graph consulted on placement: apps/ was ruled out for a build that writes to fleet stores, but the user asked to spin it up here anyway so we can play with it further. On promotion (per stores/README.md Article IV) this lifts out to its own repo — fleet_glue is not import-pure by design (its whole job is to bind Nestor+Jeles+Willow at the seams) but its core module tree does not import willow_mcp/jeles/nestor at top level: every binding is lazy inside the function that needs it.
notes.wire: hooks.install() registers a tier-1.5 recognizer through nestor.cascade.set_tier15_recognizer (decision 0205's seam). It does NOT monkeypatch cascade.translate_segment.
notes.canon_door: advisory_ratify builds a real willow_mcp.mem_ratify.RatifyRequest — proposer excluded per §0.2, quorum enforced, same-base-model witnesses flagged for human. Read-only; the caller decides whether to promote.
